title: Influence of Ligament Properties on Tibiofemoral Mechanics in Walking

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Influence of Ligament Properties on Tibiofemoral Mechanics in Walking》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Computational knee models provide a powerful platform to investigate the effects of injury and surgery on functional knee behavior.

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】The objective of this study was to use a multibody knee model to investigate the influence of ligament properties on tibiofemoral kinematics and cartilage contact pressures in the stance phase of walking.
